# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 17 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Market: New Launches & Land Sales

- **New condo sales hit lowest point since Feb 2024 in June** - Private home sales fell to just 156 units in June 2026 as no new projects launched that month, with a rebound expected as July launches come to market. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapores-new-condo-sales-plunged-65-in-june-heres-what-happened/)

- **Bayshore Drive GLS site draws record $2.128 billion bid** - A Frasers Property-led joint venture submitted the top bid of $2.128 billion at $1,323 psf ppr for the Bayshore Drive site, the largest bid ever recorded for a GLS plot outside Singapore's CBD. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/bayshore-lands-singapores-first-2-billion-non-cbd-gls-site/)

- **Dunearn House launches at $1.475 million entry price** - The new launch in the Bukit Timah area opens at a starting price of $1.475 million, with a $2,799 psf entry price that undercuts most resale and new launch options nearby. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/dunearn-house-condo-pricing-review/)

## HDB Resale & Housing Policy

- **2-room HDB flat in Queenstown sets new national resale record at S$696,000** - A high-floor 2-room flat at SkyParc @ Dawson changed hands for S$696,000 on 15 July 2026, breaking the previous national resale record for the flat type. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/2-room-national-record-broken-as-queenstown-unit-sells-for-s696000/)

- **Community Care Apartments now open from age 55, with fees cut by up to 75%** - The Government is lowering the minimum eligible age for Community Care Apartments from 65 to 55 and reducing mandatory monthly service fees by between 18% and 75%, in a joint announcement by MOH, MND and HDB. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/community-care-apartments-seniors-from-age-55-fees-reduced-by-up-to-75/)

## En Bloc & Commercial

- **People's Park Centre launches third collective sale attempt at $1.48 billion** - The mixed-use site above Chinatown MRT has relaunched its collective sale at a guide price $320 million lower than previous attempts, making it Singapore's longest-running en bloc effort on record. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/peoples-park-centre-making-third-en-bloc-attempt-320-million-lower-price/)
